name: Glow panels
source: A product launch film on a white ground in which real UI is shown as floating panels with a soft multicolour gradient glow along their edges (blue, red, yellow, green), tilted in 3D and drifting; one-line refrain titles with a single highlighted word; a search pill that becomes the mark. Described from a contact sheet; no files or pixels are carried.

frame_device.what: A near white ground with a faint cool gradient wash in one corner, and one or two panels: rounded rectangles holding real UI, each outlined by a thin, soft gradient glow (the brand's own colours) and lifted by a faint shadow. A title line sits in the centre or top when no panel is up; the panel and the title never share the frame at the same strength.
frame_device.moves: Panels glide in from depth on a tilt (rotateX 12 to 20 deg, rotateY -10 to 10 deg, rotateZ -2 to 2), settle toward flat as the content is read, then drift 2 to 4% while held; the next panel pushes the previous out along the same path. The glow edge rotates slowly around the panel's border.

ground_motion: The gradient edge glow travels: the light on the panels' edges and the ground gradient slowly orbit (30 to 40 degrees over 8 s) with a 1 to 2 percent breath in intensity; panels float 4 to 8 px on offset phases.

type.classes: Title: a clean geometric or humanist sans, regular weight, sentence case, 4 to 6% of frame height, ink on white, one word of the line in the brand's blue (or accent) as the highlight; UI text is the real UI's type at its true size scaled with the panel.
type.behaviour: The title is one line, whole and centred in the safe area. Words arrive by a soft fade and rise (0.35 s), the highlighted word last. The refrain verb stays fixed while the rest of the line changes, so only the tail swaps. UI text types in only where the real UI does.

image.treatment: Real product UI and real photography inside a panel, with rounded corners (16 to 28 px at 1080p), an inner hairline and the gradient glow outside. The product is shown at readable scale: a panel is at least 55% of the frame width when it carries text to be read.
image.behaviour: A panel enters tilted, settles, and a crop or zoom-in (scale 1 to 1.3 over the hold) goes to the part of the UI that matters; clicks, typed queries and responses play inside it. A panel can rotate in 3D to reveal the next one behind it.

transitions: panel push (the next panel enters along the same tilt path as the last leaves)
title word becomes the input (the highlighted word drops into the search pill)
glow flash on the edge as the panel changes state
zoom into the panel until its UI is the frame, then the next title
mark morph (pill, then ring, then the G or logo)

techniques.name: Tilted panel entrance
techniques.what: A UI panel enters from depth, tilted, then straightens as it settles.
techniques.route: Container with perspective 1400px; panel from translateZ(-300px) rotateX(18deg) rotateY(-12deg) opacity 0 to rest, 0.9 s expo.out; Rasan3D optional for a true camera; no blur.

techniques.name: Gradient edge glow
techniques.what: A soft multicolour glow outlines the panel and slowly travels around its border.
techniques.route: A wrapper with a conic-gradient background (brand colours) and padding 2 px, border-radius matching, filter blur(14px) on a duplicate behind it (opacity 0.6); animate the gradient angle with a registered CSS custom property or rotate the pseudo-element 360 deg in 6 s linear. Non-flat films only: a flat film uses a 2 px solid brand-colour border.

techniques.name: Refrain title with highlight
techniques.what: A one-line title card that keeps the refrain verb and changes the tail, one word picked out in colour.
techniques.route: Two spans: the fixed verb stays put; the tail fades and rises (y 12 to 0, 0.35 s power2.out) with the highlighted word 0.15 s later in the accent; hold 0.8 s; exit by opacity 0.25 s.

techniques.name: Word drops into the input
techniques.what: The highlighted word of the title travels into the search pill and becomes the typed query.
techniques.route: Measure both boxes; tween the word span from its position to the input's text origin (0.6 s power3.inOut) while the pill fades up under it; swap the span for the real input text at arrival with a set.

techniques.name: Pill expands to the panel
techniques.what: A search or prompt pill grows into the response panel, so the UI is one object that expands.
techniques.route: Animate the pill's width, height and border-radius (pill 999px to 24px) over 0.7 s expo.inOut; content crossfades in at 60% (0.25 s); glow grows with it.

techniques.name: Typed query and streamed answer
techniques.what: A real query types into the UI and the answer arrives line by line.
techniques.route: Typed text with steps at 28 to 36 cps; lines fade in with stagger 0.12 s and y 8 to 0; a caret blink at 0.5 s; use the real UI strings.

techniques.name: Panel push
techniques.what: The next panel enters along the same path the last panel leaves, a continuous glide with no cut.
techniques.route: Timeline overlap: the outgoing panel translates (z -200, y -6%, opacity to 0) over 0.6 s power2.in while the incoming enters from the opposite end of the same path (0.8 s expo.out) starting 0.3 s earlier than the exit ends.

techniques.name: UI zoom to the point
techniques.what: The camera pushes into the part of the panel that matters, until it fills the frame, then the next title takes over.
techniques.route: Scale the panel (transform-origin at the target) 1 to 2.2 over 0.9 s power3.inOut; crossfade to the title card in the last 0.2 s.

techniques.name: Card fan
techniques.what: Several result cards fan out in a tilted stack, each offset in depth, to show a set of answers.
techniques.route: Three to five cards with rotateY and translateZ stepped by 40 px, stagger 0.08 s (0.7 s expo.out); one card then lifts and flattens as the focus.

techniques.name: Pill to mark
techniques.what: The input pill collapses into the brand mark, ending the film on the logo.
techniques.route: Pill width shrinks to its height (0.5 s power3.inOut) becoming a circle; an SVG of the real mark draws its strokes in one at a time (dashoffset, 0.5 s) inside; the glow settles to a single soft ring.

techniques.name: Panels fan in real depth
techniques.what: Three real screenshots on slabs fan out in z and tilt, the focused one lights, the rest stay evenly lit.
techniques.route: Rasan3D: three `k.panel`s (screenshot via `k.image`, depth 0.06) stepped in z, rotation.y 0.38 rad, 0.12 s apart, `expo.out` 0.8 s; edge glow as a thin emissive line (`k.material("emissive", { intensity: 2.5 })`) on the focused slab only, bloom threshold 1.15, strength 0.3; lens 50 mm, DOF f/2.8 on the focused panel, motion blur on. On a flat brand drop the emissive line for a palette outline (flat 3D, `references/3d.md`).

techniques.name: Camera arcs round the panel stack
techniques.what: One slow camera arc (25 degrees) across the stack of panels reveals the next panel behind the first, then holds.
techniques.route: Rasan3D: `k.orbit({ center: stackCentre, radius: 7, from: -12, to: 13, t0, t1, ease: "power3.inOut" })` over 1.6 s; lens 60 mm; the front panel's `rotation.y` eases to -0.3 as the next one is revealed; fstop 2.8 focus on the new panel (rack focus).

techniques.name: Word choreography
techniques.what: Each word of the line enters from its own place (its own offset, scale and blur) and settles into the line with a gentle lift, instead of typing on letter by letter; the key word arrives last and lands with a little more overshoot.
techniques.route: Split the line into word spans; GSAP from each word's own x/y offset (24 to 80 px, different per word), scale 0.88 to 1.15 and blur 6 to 12 px to rest, 0.55 s, stagger 0.09 s; end with a 4 to 8 px lift settling back (y -6 to 0) on back.out(1.4) or an elastic.out(1, 0.7) tail; every word readable at rest and the line whole before the next line starts; the next line's first word starts 0.2 s before this line's last settles (overlap).

signature: One refrain verb and one real input: the title's highlighted word drops into the pill, the pill expands into the panel, and at the end the pill collapses into the mark.

density.note: A new title or a new panel state about every 1.5 s; holds of 2 to 3 s while a real answer is read. Slower than the other grammars on purpose.

palette.ground: white to a pale cool grey (#F7F9FC)
palette.accent: the brand's own 3 to 4 colours used only as glow edges and the highlighted word
palette.note: A brand palette overrides these; the devices stay. The glow needs a non-flat film: flat films use a 2 px solid brand border and a faint shadow.

do: Show real UI at a readable size
Keep the white ground quiet; let the glow be the only colour
Tilt panels, then settle them toward flat to be read
Change one word of the title each rung
Let each panel enter on the path the last one left
Hold on the answer long enough to read it
dont: Do not use fake or lorem UI
Do not stack more than two panels at once
Do not keep the tilt while a viewer must read the text
Do not use dark mode, neon or heavy blur
Do not add the glow on a flat film
